description: This file defines an Angular service named AuthService, which manages user authentication state, including login, registration, and logout functionalities. It uses localStorage to persist user data and BehaviorSubject to manage reactive state updates.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: An Angular service that handles user authentication state, including login, registration, and logout, with localStorage persistence and reactive state management.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Simulates user login by creating a user object, saving it to localStorage, updating the user observable, and returning the user.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Simulates user registration similarly to login, creating a user object, storing it, updating state, and returning the user.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears user data from localStorage, resets user state to null, and navigates to the login page.

ctags.name: displayName
ctags.pattern: /^    const user: User = { id: 'local-uid', email, displayName: null };$/
